_comment: Written by the trading runs. impliedMove is a decimal or null. null means the straddle was not pulled - an open checklist item, not a placeholder to guess at. This file is a list of what is AHEAD: the pre-close run prunes catalysts once their date has passed and re-reads spot from a live quote, because a reference price carried from the day it was written makes every implied range wrong.
prunedNote: Three entries removed by the 8/7 open run and none added, leaving one. Removed: the SMR 8/14 expiry, and this is the removal that matters, because the row was not merely stale - it described 'the open position' and its final-week deadline, and there is no open position. The calls were closed 8/6 at 15:38 ET, filled 0.49 for 98.00, read from the broker's order record. The row was a clock on something the account no longer holds, which is the same failure the 8/6 prune caught in the UPST row and is worth naming twice because it recurred within a session. Removed: MARA, whose 8/6 after-close print has landed - the file's own 8/6 note said this run should remove it, and it has. Removed: OKLO, which reported this morning at -0.28 against a -0.16 estimate; a before-open print is spent by the time an 11:57 run reads it. Left: SMCI on 8/11, whose spot is re-read from the live 11:57 bid rather than carried from 8/6, and whose impliedMove stays null because no straddle was pulled - this run stopped at the staleness guard and did not build an entry, so the item is open rather than answered.

moves.source: Re-verified on the live broker earnings calendar at 11:57 ET on 8/7: timing 'pm', verified true, estimate 0.69, no actual. spot is the live bid at 11:57 ET on 8/7, replacing the 29.68 carried from 8/6 - the name is 3.8% higher than the reference price this row was holding, which is the drift the re-read exists to prevent. This is now the only catalyst ahead of the account on any watched name; every other 8/4-8/7 print has landed. impliedMove stays null and remains an open item rather than a moot one: the account is flat with 109.88 of settled cash, so unlike every read since 8/5 an entry here is affordable, which means item 3 is the thing standing between this name and a position rather than the balance being it.

branches.cond: Any entry considered on 8/8 or later
branches.act: Pull the at-the-money straddle and write the implied move down before sizing
branches.why: A five-session hold opened Monday runs through the 8/11 print, so the print is inside the hold and item 3 binds without exception. Holding through a report is a coin flip on the implied move, taken deliberately with the number written down or not taken at all. No straddle pulled means no earnings hold - that is the rule, and it is the reason this row survives the prune while three others did not.

branches.cond: An option is considered on this name
branches.act: Refused outright while the hold would cross 8/11
branches.why: The rulebook forbids holding an option through a print. IV crush kills even a correct call, and a 3-6 week expiry from here necessarily spans 8/11. An option on SMCI is not available to this rulebook before the print regardless of what the straddle says.

branches.act: Close it, or write the hold down with the implied move attached
branches.why: An equity hold through a print gets pre-decided with the number in hand or it does not happen. The decision belongs to the 8/11 pre-close run, which is the last one that sits between the position and the report.
